title: Positivity and response are earned for an explicit family
statement: For positive nodes a_k, P(x)=product(a_k+x), r_n=x[P(x)²+P(-x)²]/[P(x)²-P(-x)²], removable at0. Source proves r_n>=|x|, globally nonnegative S_n=alpha(r_n(w)+w)/(1+w²)². Odd spectral part exactly target, Im C_n(t)=-(alpha/4)t exp(-t); excess even/nonnegative equals independent classical stationary Gaussian Hamiltonian noise. Each inserted node hasS_n(-a)=0/S_n(a)=Sstar(a), refinement monotonically lowers excess without refitting. Exact selected weak one-transition rates, not exact finite-coupling thermal generator/Lamb shifts/all-order cold bath. Classical product rational motif is prior machinery, no priority claim.

requires: Explicit dimensionless Sstar(w)=alpha(|w|+w)/(1+w²)²,alpha>0; arbitrary finite-dimensional H_S(t), bounded Hermitian Q, factorized Gaussian bath and reference; prescribed-time instruments.

Vacuum canonical coupled oscillator process is defined by finite-cutoff Cauchy limit; implementable system/control operators and paid finite coefficient precision, not an experimentally unknown bath or arbitrary unbounded GKSL extension.
